**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ICancellableEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/ICancellableEvent.java)

An event that a listener cancels to refuse the change it announces.

## Description

The `beforeX` events implement it: a `beforeMove`, `beforeChange` or `beforeClose` listener that calls `cancel()` refuses the change, and the listeners after it do not run, except the `MONITOR` ones.

- [Events](/use/learn/interactivity/events/#refuse-a-change-before-it-happens)
